name: Reachy 2
summary: Reachy 2 is an open-source humanoid upper body on an omnidirectional wheeled base, made by Pollen Robotics, now part of Hugging Face. It has two 7-DoF bio-inspired arms and runs on ROS 2 with a Python SDK. Press reported a price of $70,000 and use at labs such as Cornell and Carnegie Mellon.
sensors: Stereo and RGB-D cameras, LiDAR on the mobile base.
compute: ROS 2 Humble, Python SDK; compatible with Hugging Face LeRobot.
highlights: Hugging Face acquired Pollen Robotics in April 2025.
Uses Pollen's Orbita parallel actuators in the neck and wrists.
caveats: Upper-body humanoid on wheels, not a walking robot.
Price comes from press coverage, not a public price list.

sources.title: Now On Sale For $70,000: The World's First Factory Ready Open-Source Humanoid Robot
